title: Rollback deployment to version 42

requirements.text: Rollback the application codebase and deployment configuration to version 42, reverting any code changes introduced after version 42 across both the frontend and backend.
acceptanceCriteria: The repository state matches version 42 for both frontend and backend sources (no post-v42 changes remain).
A fresh build succeeds using the reverted version 42 codebase without internal build/deploy errors.
Deployed canisters and frontend assets correspond to version 42 behavior (no UI/functionality from versions >42 appears).

requirements.text: Ensure the deployment pipeline/build scripts select and deploy version 42 deterministically (so repeated deploy attempts do not accidentally redeploy a newer version).
acceptanceCriteria: Re-running the deploy process repeatedly results in the same version 42 artifact outputs and deployed behavior.
There is a clear, single source of truth for the deployed version (e.g., pinning to the version 42 revision/tag) used by the build/deploy steps.

constraints: Respect the existing single-actor Motoko backend architecture (all Motoko logic remains in backend/main.mo).

Do not edit frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not implement new features beyond restoring version 42.
Do not perform unrelated refactors or UI redesigns as part of the rollback.
